levels.surface: أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي

notes: «يرفعه إلى» is a gap: unnamed link, then the Imam as the chain's last narrator (kept as narrator, the same reading as the Imam after «إلى» in t10-086395)
«أبيه» is a bare relation (the father of al-Barqi), not identified
Iblis's words are the saying; the Imam relays them
